pack_c_dl008_certified.root_cause: S700 was essentially correct (51 vs 52 — missed P1-DC-019 Section D outlier). SESSION_STATUS was close (55 vs 52 — may have included 3 DL-018 items). Governance register (174) was massively wrong — likely counted via DL-029 forward-scan or included all Pack C items rather than just those with DL-008.

pack_d_dl008_certified.root_cause: S700 ~342 was a DL-029 forward-scan artifact. In Pack D, CorrectChoice is positioned BEFORE QuestionID in the JSON object. Forward-scan from QID systematically grabs the NEXT item's CC, producing ~75% false-positive rate × 500 items ≈ 340-375 false positives. SESSION_STATUS was directionally correct (found 11 of 20) but undercounted Sections A/C. Governance register BD-001 flag was a false positive.

pack_a_dl008_certified.root_cause: P1-B-001 confirmed, P1-B-025 was a false positive. B-025's EW fields are choice-specific and topically aligned; the DL-015 topic-label numbering artifact (B.026 vs expected B.025) likely triggered the false finding.

s703.title: Pack C DL-008 Remediation
s703.strategy: Batch 1: 22 DL-008_ONLY (simple EW[CC] clear, no CC audit needed). Batches 2-4: 30 DL-008_PLUS_DL-016 (CC audit first, then EW[CC] clear or CC correction).
s703.critical_warning: For 30 items with DL-016 shift, clearing EW[CC] without auditing CC risks clearing the wrong slot. The metadata block's EW alignment may not match the content block's CorrectChoice. Use G-NEW-3 within-object extraction.

s704.title: Pack D Parse Repair + DL-008 Remediation

s704.strategy: Step 1: Fix BD-095 missing comma (mechanical, 1 edit). Step 2: Clear EW[CC] on 20 DL-008 items (all DL-008_ONLY — simple clear). Step 3: Assess FD-046 (shell item — either populate content fields or set to Archived).
s704.critical_warning: Do not edit FD-045 or FD-075 — both are structurally complete. AGENTS.md §13.2 FD-045 CAPA can proceed.
